entries.title: Runt
entries.details: Runt is about a girl called Annie, who adopted street dog she called Runt. So they entered a competition because they don't have enough money to save the farm from drought. Unfortunately they didn't win, but the rain saved the farm. Roy's note: Always try your best, even you might not make it, sometimes luck is on your side!

entries.title: Blinky Bill
entries.details: Mrs Koala once had a son called Blinky Bill, he was trying to escape home to go on adventures. Along the journey he stole some food becaue he was hungry and curious, but nearly got shot. Finally Blinky found his way home capturd by a man, then he was sent to the zoo with his mum. Roy's note: You must have permission to other people's things even if you are really curious!

entries.title: Anne of Green Gables
entries.details: Marilla and Matthew were lonely and wanted to have a child but they are already old, so they borrowed a boy from as an orphan. But instead of a boy, they recieved a girl called Anne. She tried to enjoy her life but the family gor robbed and Metthew passed away. She still tried to get the best of it and enjoy her life. Roy's note: You only have one life, try to make the best of it, and pursue your dreams!

entries.title: I survived the Titanic
entries.details: This book is about Aunt Daisy taking George and Phoebe on the Titanic, but it sank, but they managed to survive. I learnt about how Titanic sank.
